body:
Founder real-time flagged both as 'really important' -- constrain-Y (checked by default) locks object-mode drag to the horizontal plane unless unchecked; undo/redo is a plain React history stack (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Z + toolbar buttons), deliberately not Redux per NOCK's own established precedent. Commit 421fa58.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK level editor: constrain-Y drag + undo/redo
